# The Portland Medium

> The Portland Medium is a community journalism platform dedicated to covering news, culture, and issues affecting the Portland Black community and broader African American experience.

The Portland Medium provides local news coverage from Portland, Oregon, alongside national stories and cultural content. The publication focuses on topics including housing policy, civil rights, entertainment, sports, and community issues affecting Black communities.

## Key Topics

- Portland, Oregon
- Local News
- Affordable Housing
- Community Journalism
- African American Media
- Civil Rights
- Entertainment
- Sports Coverage
- College Basketball
- Health & Lifestyle
- Editorials
- National News
- Policy & Government
- Cultural Coverage
- Community Alerts

## Local News & Community

- [Oregon Housing Crisis: Senate Passes Bynum's Bills](https://theportlandmedium.com/local-news/oregon-housing-bills-passed): News on housing bills by Rep. Janelle Bynum passed to address Oregon housing crisis.
- [Rising Costs Continue To Challenge Portland Housing Development](https://theportlandmedium.com/local-news/rising-develpment-costs-housing): Analysis of rising development costs and financing challenges in Portland housing.
- [Portland's Housing Boost: New Incentive Shows Promise](https://theportlandmedium.com/local-news/construction-boost-portland-program): Report on Portland's new financial incentive program boosting housing construction.
- [Portland Mayor Proposes Permanent PCCEP Establishment](https://theportlandmedium.com/local-news/portland-mayor-proposes-pccep-ordinance): News on Mayor Wilson's proposal to permanently establish community police oversight.
- [Multnomah County Seeks Help in Identifying Remains](https://theportlandmedium.com/local-news/african-american-man-remains): Community alert from Multnomah County seeking help identifying remains in Portland.
- [Senators Urge Timely Delivery of Farmworker Student Funds](https://theportlandmedium.com/local-news/senators-urge-timely-delivery-funds): News on senators' push for federal farmworker student education funding delivery.

## Civil Rights & Culture

- [Jesse Jackson, Pioneer of Multiracial America, Has Passed](https://theportlandmedium.com/video/jesse-jackson-civil-rights-leaders-legacy): Obituary and legacy coverage of civil rights leader Rev. Jesse Jackson.
- [Lacks Family Secures Settlement in HeLa Cell Case](https://theportlandmedium.com/lifestyle/health-lifestyle/lacks-family-justice-settlement): Article on Henrietta Lacks estate settlement with Novartis over HeLa cell exploitation.
- [Indiana Women Champion Black History Through Mobile Bookstore](https://theportlandmedium.com/video/black-history-month-book-movement): Feature on Indiana entrepreneurs launching mobile bookstore for Black history and literature.
- [Black Women's Portrayal in Oscars Contenders](https://theportlandmedium.com/op-ed/editorials/black-women-oscar-representation): Editorial on Black women representation in Oscar-nominated films and Hollywood tropes.

## Entertainment & Sports

- ['Sinners' Star Miles Caton Talks About His Big Break](https://theportlandmedium.com/entertainment/miles-caton-sinners-oscar-buzz): Entertainment interview with Miles Caton on his role in Oscar-nominated film 'Sinners'.
- [Jeremy Fears Jr.: From Hard Fouls to NCAA Success](https://theportlandmedium.com/sports/fears-izzo-michigan-state-basketball): Sports profile of Jeremy Fears Jr. and Michigan State basketball under Tom Izzo.

## National News & Policy

- [TSA Employees Suffer as Lawmakers Clash over Funding](https://theportlandmedium.com/news/national-news/tsa-agents-unpaid-shutdown): National news on TSA employees going unpaid during government funding shutdown.
- [New AI Legislative Plan From White House to Congress](https://theportlandmedium.com/news/national-news/trump-ai-regulation-framework): National news on White House AI regulation framework to prevent state-level regulation.
